audit_member_text: [L17,L28] (LOW/format-type-mismatch) CLOG_int32_t is __int32 while i32fmt requests long, leaving a variadic type mismatch on compilers where __int32 aliases int even though Win32 gives both types equal width.

adversarial.rationale: The active header typedef is __int32 and i32fmt is %ld, with no format cast or compiler-specific correction elsewhere in the tree.
